text.title: Growth Viral Loops Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable loop signals (sharing moment, event instrumentation, K decomposition, incentive design) to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the product have a named event where the user shares, invites or sends to another person as part of getting their own value (collaboration, messaging, publishing, splitting)?

conclusion.verdict: no inherent loop to specify; run an activation or acquisition methodology instead, or design the sharing feature first

branch.question: Do invite_sent and invite_accepted (and invitee_activated) events exist and share an invite_id plus the inviter's user_id?

conclusion.verdict: first deliverable is the five-event instrumentation plan; no K target until events are joinable

branch.question: Is K written as invites-per-user x accept-rate from those events, with cycle time measured from send to first-send timestamps?

conclusion.verdict: compute i, c and cycle time from the joined events over at least two full cycles before setting any target

branch.question: Does the loop pay any reward (credit, discount, cash, feature unlock) to the referrer or the invitee?

conclusion.verdict: reward triggers on the activation milestone, caps and self-referral block stated; then apply r-referral-consent-and-disclosure and run the checklist
inherent loop with joinable events and decomposed K; write the spec with the projection and the friction experiments

text.example: sharing_moment_exists=true -> events_joinable=true -> k_decomposed=true -> incentivised=false -> conclusion ref=run-the-checklist
